topic: Youth groups held a silent protest in Colombo against corruption and the old political culture; medical students protested near the University Grants Commission against privatisation of medical education
quote1: “අලුත් පියපත්” සංවිධානය සහ තවත් තරුණ කණ්ඩායම් කිහිපයක් එක්ව මෙම විරෝධතාව සංවිධානය කර තිබිණි.
quote2: A protest was held by Medical students, over attempts to futher privatise medical education, near the University Grants Commission in Colombo this week.
